description:
A useful subsidy offer can be easy to lose in a busy game. Subsidy Manager keeps your offers, accepted tasks and past outcomes together in one window, so you can spend more time planning your routes.

Overview
• Offered: compare destinations, requirements, rewards and remaining time before accepting a contract.
• In Progress: follow accepted tasks, progress and deadlines.
• History: review successful and failed subsidies while the game retains them.
• Click a row to open the game's full subsidy details, highlight locations and use the usual Accept or Decline controls.

How to use it
Click the contract icon beside Industry Statistics in the bottom-right toolbar. Choose a section, then click a subsidy for its details. Press Refresh to bring the overview up to date while it is open.

A small dot on the toolbar icon marks new offers since your last successful manager opening. You can move and pin the window. When every section is empty, it uses a compact layout with helpful guidance.

Auto-decline
Prefer to skip new subsidy offers? Enable Auto-decline beside Refresh.
• Off by default; your choice is saved for this game.
• Declines offers arriving after you enable it, checking about every five seconds.
• Existing offers and accepted tasks are left alone.
• Turn it off to choose future offers yourself. Declined offers cannot be restored.

Good to know
• Refresh is manual; the toolbar dot and Auto-decline do not update the table.
• The game owns subsidy rules, rewards and history. Older history entries can disappear when the game removes them.
• A dash means the game's overview did not provide that value. Hover for an explanation, or open the full details.
• Worker progress shows the game's workforce-boost percentage, rather than a transported passenger count.
• No default keyboard shortcut is added. English is the supplied language.

Changes
v1.2.0 — Auto-decline new offers
• Added an optional Auto-decline toggle beside Refresh, off by default, with a short explanatory tooltip.
• Your Auto-decline choice is saved per game. Existing offers and accepted tasks are preserved.
• Reorganised this description into an overview, usage guidance and release history.
• Added a real-game gallery image showing Auto-decline and its tooltip.

v1.1.2 — Clearer overview and more reliable progress
• History shows each outcome once in Status, without a duplicate Result column.
• Missing values, including progress, use a dash with an explanatory tooltip.
• Clearer guidance when data cannot be read, and a more accurate empty History message.
• More available progress and rewards remain visible when a subsidy is difficult to read.
• Genuine zero worker progress appears as 0% Workers.

v1.1.1 — Clearer guidance
• Clearer instructions for finding offers, following accepted tasks and reviewing past outcomes.
• Clarified that Refresh updates the overview while the manager is open.

v1.1.0 — Easier-to-read tables and a fresh look
• Payments, bonuses and other effects appear on separate lines. Long rewards and durations wrap instead of being cut off.
• Better reward and deadline spacing, with rows that grow to fit their text.
• Illustrated empty views with section-specific guidance and a compact window when every section is empty.
• Refreshed cover and gallery showing the toolbar, updated tables and empty views.

v1.0.1 — Description update
• Improved the Mod Hub summary and description.

v1.0.0 — Initial release
• Added the toolbar launcher and Offered, In Progress and History views with counts.
• Compare subsidy resources, requirements, rewards and deadlines in one place.
• Open the game’s subsidy details and map highlights directly from a row, with the usual Accept and Decline controls.
• Manual Refresh and a movable, pinnable window with a compact all-empty layout.
name: Subsidy Manager
summary: Compare subsidy offers, follow your progress and find your next opportunity in one place.
